host_galaxy.comment:
Krühler+2015: Paper Table 2 and Appendix A.4 give z=3.1±0.1 from the Ly-alpha break in the X-shooter spectral continuum, consistent with GROND photometry; this paper value is used instead of the conflicting CDS z=4.0000. Coordinates are J2000 eq_FK5 positions from Simbad via the CDS/VizieR table, not new astrometry measured by this paper. The paper states that fluxes, spectra, and photometry are corrected for Galactic foreground reddening; incidental AB magnitudes therefore have gext_corr=true.
Krühler+2015: Source access: CDS/VizieR J/A+A/581/A125 plus arXiv HTML for paper-only values and appendices; the A&A full-text route returned 403.
Merged-field decision: host coordinates taken from Krühler+2015 according to the direct-measurement priority rule.
Merged-field decision: redshift, error, and type taken as one tuple from Krühler+2015 according to the recency/method priority rule.
